company.name: CRYO Holdings
company.shortDescription: CRYO Holdings is a wellness, recovery, and cryotherapy company.
company.description: CRYO focuses on delivering non-invasive wellness and recovery treatments using extremely low temperatures to stimulate physical recovery, circulation, metabolism, pain relief, beauty enhancement, and overall wellbeing. The company combines cryotherapy with complementary wellness treatments to create a complete recovery and performance ecosystem.

productsAndServices.description: A treatment exposing the entire body to extremely cold air at temperatures as low as -140°C for up to three minutes to stimulate blood circulation and metabolic activity.

productsAndServices.description: A targeted cold therapy applied to specific body areas to reduce pain, inflammation, and improve skin and wellness conditions.
productsAndServices.name: Localized Cryotherapy

productsAndServices.description: Facial therapies using cryotherapy and related technologies to improve skin condition, reduce wrinkles, and enhance skin texture.
productsAndServices.name: °CRYO Facial Treatments

productsAndServices.description: A treatment using controlled pressure to improve circulation, reduce swelling, and aid muscle recovery.

productsAndServices.description: A treatment using red and near-infrared light to stimulate cellular function, promote healing, and improve skin health.
productsAndServices.name: Red Light Therapy

productsAndServices.description: A sauna treatment using infrared light to heat the body directly, promoting relaxation, detoxification, and circulation.
productsAndServices.name: Infrared Sauna
